name: COUNTIFS
description: COUNTIFS counts cells that satisfy multiple criteria across one or more ranges.
tldr: Counts cells that meet all of the specified conditions.

parameters.name: criteria_range1
parameters.description: The range to evaluate with the first criteria.

parameters.name: criteria1
parameters.description: The condition that criteria_range1 must satisfy.

basicExample.description: Count orders from the East region
basicExample.explanation: Counts how many cells in A2:A100 contain "East".

advancedExamples.title: Multiple criteria
advancedExamples.description: Count orders where region is East and status is Completed
advancedExamples.explanation: Only rows matching both criteria are counted.

advancedExamples.title: Numeric range
advancedExamples.explanation: Uses two criteria on the same numeric range.

howItWorks: COUNTIFS iterates through each cell in the criteria ranges. It counts a row only if every criterion is satisfied. Empty cells are ignored unless the criteria explicitly matches blank.

howToSteps.name: Select criteria range
howToSteps.text: Choose the range for the first condition.

howToSteps.name: Add more pairs
howToSteps.text: Include additional range/criteria pairs for more conditions.

limitations: All criteria ranges must be the same size and shape.
Criteria are combined with AND logic.
Counts cells, not numeric values; use SUMIFS for adding values.

commonErrors.fix: Make all ranges the same dimensions.

commonErrors.cause: Criteria includes hidden spaces or wrong data type.
commonErrors.fix: Use TRIM to clean text and check number formatting.

googleSheetsEquivalent.description: COUNTIFS works identically in Google Sheets.
googleSheetsEquivalent.notes: Same syntax and behavior as Excel.

faq.question: What is the difference between COUNTIF and COUNTIFS?
faq.answer: COUNTIF handles one condition. COUNTIFS handles multiple conditions.

faq.question: Can COUNTIFS count blank cells?
faq.answer: Yes, use "" as the criteria to count empty cells.

faq.question: Does COUNTIFS count text or numbers?
faq.answer: It counts cells that match the criteria, regardless of whether they contain text or numbers.

faq.question: Can I use cell references as criteria?
faq.answer: Yes, use the cell reference directly without quotes.
